title.zh: 汇丰：港元稳定币RedCoin上线一周吸引约5万客户，目标百万用户群
title.en: 汇丰：港元稳定币RedCoin上线一周吸引约5万客户，目标百万用户群

current_state.zh: HSBC CEO Georges Elhedery said the bank's licensed HKD retail stablecoin RedCoin drew about 50,000 customers in its first week after going live via PayMe, with merchant payments and P2P transfers enabled and plans to scale to millions of users and integrate tokenized-asset subscriptions into the HSBC Hong Kong app.
current_state.en: HSBC CEO Georges Elhedery said the bank's licensed HKD retail stablecoin RedCoin drew about 50,000 customers in its first week after going live via PayMe, with merchant payments and P2P transfers enabled and plans to scale to millions of users and integrate tokenized-asset subscriptions into the HSBC Hong Kong app.
